|strategy=By [mailto:GRSwindlehu@aol.com GRSwindlehu@aol.com]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/coruscant/light/small/captainpanaka.html</ref>

Finally, they're bringing out the Royal Guards... for the Light Side! Along with her Jedi protectors, this leader of the Queen's Guard is handy to have around &#150; especially to pick off unwanted characters.

[[Captain Panaka]] may not have Jedi stats, but his game text and matching weapon say enough. Put [[Panaka's Blaster]] on him and he fires it for free, draws weapon destiny +2, and, if he hits, your opponent loses 2 Force. Pretty sharp shootin'! The real kicker? He gets his matching weapon from Reserve Deck! Now that's card efficiency.

His stats are like [[General Solo]] or [[Grand Moff Tarkin{{!}}Tarkin]], making him a strong character. All for deploy of 4, or 3 at Amidala's location, and a forfeit of 6. You might just find a reason to make some room for this sharpshooter &#150; and his gun &#150; in your deck.

Combos:

Great chance to hit a Dark Jedi with a blaster, nearly impossible to miss others!
